classification.difficultyReason: Distinguish cumulative counts from individual class frequencies, subtract overlapping totals, and use the overall total to recover the middle class.

inlines.text: 80 people are asked how many emails they received yesterday.
30 people said they received 10 or fewer emails.
Use the data to complete this table.
Complete counts and totals consistently across the frequency table. Add frequencies to obtain the number of observations.
